exposure: perinatal exposure to maternal SARS-CoV-2 infection (asymptomatic/mild vs severe/critical COVID-19)
cohort: 101 neonates born to 100 mothers positive for or with suspected SARS-CoV-2 infection from March 13 to April 24, 2020, at a large academic medical center in New York, New York.
finding: No clinical evidence of vertical transmission of SARS-CoV-2 was identified in the newborns, despite most rooming-in and direct breastfeeding, although maternal severe/critical COVID-19 was associated with earlier birth and increased risk of requiring phototherapy.
gest_age: median gestational age 37.9 weeks (IQR, 37.1-38.4) for newborns of mothers with severe/critical COVID-19 and 39.1 weeks (IQR, 38.3-40.2) for newborns of mothers with asymptomatic/mild COVID-19
